title: On quantitative sufficient second-order optimality conditions for elliptic optimal control problems
summary: In this paper, a general principle for coercivity in optimal control problems is investigated. Utilizing regularity properties of solutions to second-order elliptic PDEs on Lipschitz domains, we provide quantitative sufficient second-order optimality condition for control-constrained semilinear elliptic optimal control problems. The main property of the investigated optimal control problems is the absence of a Tikhonov regularization term on the objective function.
